study_purpose.text: This study aims to examine patient outcomes following risk stratification for low back pain in Family Medicine combined with either matched physical therapy or current treatment.

who_may_join.text: Eligible participants are adults aged 18-64 with non-specific low back pain lasting at least 12 weeks.

patient_facing_summary.text: This study involves adults aged 18-64 with non-specific low back pain lasting at least 12 weeks. Participants will attend yoga classes, complete questionnaires, and undergo imaging tests and blood tests. No specific risks or burdens are mentioned.
